resources.string: Choose which sessions to follow and when to receive reminders.
Notifications are blocked in Android settings. Enable them to receive reminders.
Precise scheduling is allowed. Delivery also depends on device settings.
Android may delay reminders, even past the session start. Precise scheduling is optional; delivery also depends on device restrictions.
No future reminders. Check session choices and sync the calendar. Sessions without a start time are skipped.

The calendar checks for changes approximately every 12 hours while enabled and online. Saved reminders work offline; sessions with unknown times and late new reminders are skipped. Changes since the last update may not be known.
